mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT tag_category FROM leetcode_problem_tag ORDER BY tag_category
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leetcode_problem_tag (problem_id, tag_name, tag_category, relevance_score, is_primary) VALUES (#{problemId}, #{tagName}, #{tagCategory}, #{relevanceScore}, #{primary}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tag_category = VALUES(tag_category), relevance_score = VALUES(relevance_score), is_primary = VALUES(is_primary)

INSERT INTO leetcode_problem_tag (problem_id, tag_name, tag_category, relevance_score, is_primary) VALUES
(#{tag.problemId}, #{tag.tagName}, #{tag.tagCategory}, #{tag.relevanceScore}, #{tag.primary})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tag_category = VALUES(tag_category), relevance_score = VALUES(relevance_score), is_primary = VALUES(is_primary)
